# RickBroider.com

Rick Broider is a 30-year tech veteran, regenerative systems architect, and operational coherence strategist for mission-driven founders, operators, conscious investors, regenerative organizations, and teams navigating founder bottlenecks, role confusion, governance drift, organizational memory loss, AI workflow fragmentation, and collapse patterns.

- https://rickbroider.com/ - identity hub, ecosystem, operator proof, projects, media kit routing, and contact.
- https://rickbroider.com/media-kit/ - podcast one-sheet, short bio, headshot, episode angles, and media booking context.
- https://rickbroider.com/founder-bottleneck/ - founder bottleneck, founder burnout, ownership transfer.
- https://rickbroider.com/organizational-memory/ - source-backed memory, decisions, tasks, risks, continuity.
- https://rickbroider.com/ai-supported-operations/ - human-centered AI workflows and operational context.
- https://rickbroider.com/regenerative-operating-systems/ - roles, governance, repair loops, execution rhythm.
- https://rickbroider.com/collapse-pattern-diagnostics/ - burnout, avoidance, governance drift, momentum loss.
- https://rickbroider.com/teal-governance-role-clarity/ - distributed authority, role clarity, decision rights.
- https://rickbroider.com/saberra-founder-story/ - Saberra founder story, source-backed organizational memory, human-approved AI, regenerative revenue model.
